changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql:
if exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[ROUTINES] where SPECIFIC_SCHEMA = 'integration' and SPECIFIC_NAME = 'GetObjectIDByAssetTypeId') begin IF EXISTS (SELECT f.name FROM sys.Computed_columns f inner join sys.objects o on f.object_id = o.object_id where SCHEMA_NAME(schema_id) = 'integration' and o.name = 'SynchedAssetType' and F.name ='ObjectID' and f.is_computed = 1 ) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [integration].[SynchedAssetType] DROP column [ObjectID] END
drop FUNCTION [integration].[GetObjectIDByAssetTypeId] end
changeSet.rollback:
if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[ROUTINES] where SPECIFIC_SCHEMA = 'integration' and SPECIFIC_NAME = 'GetObjectIDByAssetTypeId') begin EXEC('CREATE FUNCTION [integration].[GetObjectIDByAssetTypeId] ( @id int ) RETURNS int AS BEGIN DECLARE @o int
SELECT @o = [ObjectID] from AssetType where ID = @id
RETURN @o END') end
